alerts.name: SQL Injection
alerts.solution: Do not trust client side input. Use prepared statements.

alerts.name: Cross Site Scripting (Reflected)
alerts.desc: Cross-site Scripting (XSS) is an attack technique that involves echoing attacker-supplied code into a user's browser instance.

alerts.name: CORS Misconfiguration
alerts.desc: This CORS misconfiguration could allow an attacker to perform AJAX queries to the vulnerable website from a malicious page loaded by the victim's user agent.
alerts.solution: Do not reflect the Origin header with credentials allowed.

alerts.name: Absence of Anti-CSRF Tokens
alerts.desc: No Anti-CSRF tokens were found in a HTML submission form.
alerts.solution: Use a vetted library or framework that prevents this weakness.

alerts.alert: Content Security Policy (CSP) Header Not Set
alerts.name: Content Security Policy (CSP) Header Not Set
alerts.desc: Content Security Policy (CSP) is an added layer of security that helps to detect and mitigate certain types of attacks.
alerts.solution: Ensure that your web server is configured to set the Content-Security-Policy header.

alerts.name: Missing Anti-clickjacking Header
alerts.desc: The response does not include either Content-Security-Policy with 'frame-ancestors' directive or X-Frame-Options.

alerts.name: Directory Browsing
alerts.desc: It is possible to view the directory listing.

alerts.name: Strict-Transport-Security Header Not Set
alerts.desc: HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS) is a web security policy mechanism.
alerts.solution: Ensure that your web server is configured to enforce Strict-Transport-Security.

alerts.name: Cookie No HttpOnly Flag
alerts.desc: A cookie has been set without the HttpOnly flag.
alerts.solution: Ensure that the HttpOnly flag is set for all cookies.

alerts.alert: Server Leaks Version Information via "Server" HTTP Response Header Field
alerts.name: Server Leaks Version Information
alerts.desc: The web/application server is leaking version information via the "Server" HTTP response header.
alerts.solution: Configure the server to suppress the Server header or provide generic details.
